name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
label: Quest
description: Delivery to Jes'rimon: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have a fence in Orgrimmar. He resides in The Drag. He's difficult to nail down if you don't know where to look, but if you go looking in one of the highest buildings there you should have no problem finding him.
Do me a favor though, don't go shouting to all of Kalimdor that he's there and what his business is--it'd be bad for both of us.
He'll give us more than a fair price for the Tablet of Jin'yael. I'm not sure why, but you should have seen how excited he was to hear about its whereabouts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, what you be needin', mon? I got many tings to be takin' care of today, and you not be on me agenda as one of them. Pester me, and I make sure that changes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahhh, Jediga be sendin' her package all the way from Azshara. Good. I be waitin' on this.
Jediga, now that be a fine woman... Deadly too. What could be better?
Look at this... The tablet be in perfect condition. You make a good messenger, friend.
